therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Encorafenib + Cetuximab (doublet) or Encorafenib + Binimetinib + Cetuximab (triplet)
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: MAPK pathway suppression and tumor cell proliferation inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Previously treated patients with BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Overall Survival (OS) and Objective Response Rate (ORR) by BICR

results.effect_size: Triplet arm median OS 9.82 months vs control 5.88 months; ORR triplet 26.1% vs control 1.9%
results.target_engagement_evidence: BRAF V600E mutation required for enrollment; PK data confirmed drug exposure for encorafenib, binimetinib, and cetuximab
biomarker_changes: Encorafenib AUClast Cycle 1: 11300 ng/mL*h, Cycle 2: 6660 ng/mL*h
Binimetinib AUClast Cycle 1: 1960 ng/mL*h, Cycle 2: 1540 ng/mL*h
Cetuximab AUClast Cycle 1: 841000 ng/mL*h, Cycle 2: 970000 ng/mL*h
Creatine kinase elevation more frequent in triplet arm (18 participants) vs doublet (1) and control (3)
Creatinine elevation more frequent in triplet arm (45 participants) vs doublet (11) and control (6)
LVEF decrease to Grade 2 in 27 triplet arm participants vs 0 doublet and 0 control
subgroup_findings: Doublet arm median OS 9.40 months vs control 5.88 months (p<0.0001)
Triplet vs doublet OS not significantly different (p=0.5958)
Triplet PFS by BICR 4.30 months vs control 1.51 months (p<0.0001)
Doublet PFS by BICR 4.21 months vs control 1.51 months (p<0.0001)
Triplet vs doublet PFS not significantly different (p=0.1004 by BICR)
Doublet ORR by BICR 20.4% vs control 1.9% (p<0.0001)
Triplet vs doublet ORR not significantly different by BICR (p=0.1928)
Safety lead-in ORR by investigator 52.8%, by BICR 41.7%
Safety lead-in median PFS by investigator 8.08 months, by BICR 5.59 months
safety_signals: 37 participants with AEs in safety lead-in
30 participants with dose interruptions, 16 with dose modifications, 8 with discontinuations due to AEs in safety lead-in
Higher rates of hemoglobin decrease in triplet arm (97 participants) vs doublet (30) and control (17)
Higher neutropenia in control arm (65) vs doublet (8) and triplet (4)
Higher leukopenia in control arm (51) vs doublet (9) and triplet (2)
QTcF prolongation more frequent in doublet arm
LVEF decreases more frequent in triplet arm
Intestinal obstruction: triplet 11, doublet 12, control 7 serious AEs

dose_info.dose: Encorafenib once daily; Binimetinib twice daily; Cetuximab standard of care
dose_info.dose_modifications: 30 participants had dose interruptions, 16 had dose modifications due to AEs in safety lead-in

context.duration: Maximum treatment exposure: triplet arm 277.4 weeks, doublet arm 268 weeks, control arm 108 weeks

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Cetuximab blocks EGFR-mediated reactivation of the MAPK pathway that occurs as a resistance mechanism to BRAF inhibition, thereby amplifying the anti-tumor biology of encorafenib in BRAF V600E-mutant colorectal cancer
modulation_entries.citation: Study of Encorafenib + Cetuximab Plus or Minus Binimetinib vs. Irinotecan/Cetuximab or Infusional 5-FU/FA/Irinotecan (FOLFIRI)/Cetuximab in Patients With BRAF V600E-mutant Metastatic Colorectal Cancer

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Binimetinib (MEK inhibitor) was hypothesized to further suppress MAPK pathway reactivation downstream of BRAF inhibition, but triplet vs doublet comparisons showed no significant improvement in OS (p=0.5958), PFS (p=0.1004), or ORR (p=0.1928 by BICR)
modulation_entries.citation: Phase 3: Overall Survival (OS) in Triplet Arm vs. Doublet Arm: Triplet 9.82 months vs Doublet 9.40 months, p=0.5958; PFS Triplet vs Doublet p=0.1004 by BICR
